kill_switch.comment: OFF by default. Detection/attribution only; per-node enforcement stays in WFP kernel driver. Set true to activate cluster coordination.

identity.comment: node_id MUST be unique within the cluster. role: sensor | coordinator | aggregator.

heartbeat.comment: Each missed heartbeat degrades health: healthy -> degraded -> unhealthy -> dead. dead_threshold = misses before DEAD state.

cross_node_aggregation.comment: Same source IP hitting N nodes within window_ms escalates severity. 2 nodes -> HIGH; 3+ -> CRITICAL.

threat_intel.comment: When full, evict the entry with lowest confidence score.

leader_election.comment: Highest active NodeId wins. Simple and deterministic - no Paxos/Raft complexity needed for NIDS cluster.

federation_protocol.transport: TBD - adapter choice: gRPC / ZeroMQ / REST
federation_protocol.comment: Core module is transport-agnostic; adapters feed messages via ClusterCoord.ingest(msg).

severity_policy.critical: 3+ nodes OR ML score >= 0.90 OR critical reason
